description: Built and maintained features across the stack - React on the front, Express and MongoDB in the back. Integrated real-world APIs like OpenWeather and Leaflet into student-facing apps. SIMS, the college management system I built here, has 500+ students registered on it. Not a demo project.

Elected Technical Co-Lead for CSI-CATT 2026-27. Leading the technical wing of the college's Computer Society chapter - driving workshops, events, and the chapter's dev projects. Went from contributor to the person setting the technical direction.
End-to-end ownership: design, MERN development, deployment, polish. No handoffs, no excuses. Every project has been a lesson in what it actually takes to ship something you're proud of.
